install.q: How do I install my first ARK server?
install.a: Click "Install Server" in the Server Manager and follow the wizard to set up your ASA server.

multiple.q: Can I run multiple servers at once?
multiple.a: Yes! You can run as many servers as your hardware can handle.

mods.a: Go to Mod Manager, search for mods, and click Install. They'll be automatically configured.

crash.a: Enable auto-restart in Settings. The manager will automatically restart crashed servers.
